card.name: Words just before salt or chemical compound terms
card.fires_on: The ending of 'Nephrogenic' in 'Nephrogenic Systemic Fibrosis' warnings, and small linking words (to, of, in) in sentences about salt or chemical components.

modes.label: Nephrogenic Systemic Fibrosis
modes.description: The final piece of 'Nephrogenic' in GBCA contrast-agent warning headings.

modes.label: Linking words near salt
modes.description: Small words like to, of or in in text about salt or chemical compounds.

card.writes: It suppresses salt and chemical-salt words such as sulfate, chloride and nitrate as the next word.
card.plain: It fires at the end of 'Nephrogenic' and on small linking words in salt-related sentences, and it makes salt names less likely to come next.
